description: Direct TypeScript consumer tests of portable production Rust/Wasm. Fault injection is explicit; this is bridge evidence, not browser/native UI, physical pen or latency acceptance.

cases.expected: Rejected actions preserve drafts; accepted Undo cancels once and leased transform scenes suppress the original.
testIds: node:apps/web/tests/editor.test.ts:portable Wasm actions preserve rejected drafts and cancel accepted Undo once
node:apps/web/tests/editor.test.ts:portable Wasm leased scenes reuse unchanged geometry and suppress preview original

cases.expected: Issued export, read, cancellation and stale-result lifecycle preserve clean/dirty state and newer documents; rejected New retains an active import.
testIds: node:apps/web/tests/files.test.ts:portable Wasm issued exports preserve dirty and clean reopened state
node:apps/web/tests/files.test.ts:portable Wasm delayed reads retire after intervening draft without overwriting input
node:apps/web/tests/files.test.ts:portable Wasm corrupt and oversized read failures retain the document
node:apps/web/tests/files.test.ts:portable Wasm rejected New preserves pending read; explicit cancellation retires after later New

cases.expected: Actual Wasm memory growth, output exhaustion and rejected work transfer preserve caller ownership.
testIds: node:apps/web/tests/transport.test.ts:portable Wasm memory growth reacquires views and output exhaustion preserves owner
node:apps/web/tests/transport.test.ts:portable Wasm rejected work transfer retains ownership for valid completion

cases.expected: Paged geometry remains complete; bounded admission retains a coherent old frame; live changes reuse unchanged committed descriptors.
testIds: node:apps/web/tests/scenes.test.ts:portable Wasm scene pages beyond descriptor and geometry caps remain complete
node:apps/web/tests/scenes.test.ts:portable Wasm bounded geometry admission retains previous coherent frame at capacity
node:apps/web/tests/scenes.test.ts:portable Wasm live scene generations reuse unchanged committed root descriptors

cases.expected: Injected transport and scene failures retain coherent state or quarantine traps; a consumed Finish result survives subsequent admission failure until shutdown.
testIds: node:apps/web/tests/injected-failures.test.ts:injected scene page failure retains coherent previous frame and retires staging lease
node:apps/web/tests/injected-failures.test.ts:injected genuine Wasm trap quarantines transport and does not call cleanup exports
node:apps/web/tests/injected-failures.test.ts:injected capacity rejection after actual Finish retains result until controlled shutdown
